text:
Priya: quick check — planning a small smoke/throughput sweep for continuous-batching (cb) tuning today. goal: validate new queue-window heuristics + var max_tokens settings on staging. need: a) loadgen slot for 30m b) sample payloads (small/med/large) c) someone to watch p99/p95 traces.
Marco: I can run loadgen after 17:00 UTC, have a 1h slot. can you drop the exact commands and payload dirs? @loadgen-bot do we have a free slot? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
loadgen-bot: scheduled slot reserved at 17:15 UTC for test-run-176534 (30m). see /loadgen/runs/176534-test-run-176534.json
Priya: awesome — thanks. sample commands: 
```bash
# small-window smoke (window=8ms, max_batch=16)
python tools/loadgen.py --target staging --duration 1800 \n  --qwindow-ms 8 --max-batch 16 --concurrency 40 \n  --payload-dir samples/cb/small

# var max_tokens sweep (32/128/512)
python tools/loadgen.py --target staging --duration 900 \n  --qwindow-ms 16 --max-batch 32 --concurrency 60 \n  --payload-dir samples/cb/var-max-tokens --max-tokens 32,128,512
```
Priya: sample payloads are in `samples/cb/` (small.jsonl, med.jsonl, large.jsonl). please use med.jsonl for baseline.
Jess: quick note — if we flip heuristics to prefer short-window for latency sensitive routes, watch for throughput cliff when mixing large payloads. saw a regression earlier: 
```
2026-02-14T12:03:21Z WARN cb_coordinator: large_requests_starve_small_window=true current_qdepth=48
```
Daniel: on test ownership — I can watch traces and export p50/p95/p99 to the dashboard. what metric names do you want? (tokens/s, req/s, p99_ms_core, cold_kv_miss_rate)
Priya: perfect. include `tokens/s`, `req/s`, `p99_ms_core`, `queue_time_ms_p95`. add a custom tag `cb-experiment:176534`.
Marco: running the first small-window smoke now. I'm kicking off with concurrency=40 and will toggle `--max-batch` after 10min to see slope. pinging here when first run finishes.
ci-bot: PR #4217 (cb: heuristic-window-fallback) passed unit tests and staging build. tag @Jess for review.
Jess: I'll review #4217 while watching the run. if I see perf regressions I'll request a rollback option in the rollout config.
Marco: first run done (17:28 UTC). quick numbers: req/s ~ 1,100, tokens/s ~ 58k, p99 ~ 42ms, queue_time_ms_p95 ~ 6ms. no obvious CPU/GPU throttles in node metrics.
Priya: nice. can you rerun with `--max-batch 64` and same payload to see tradeoffs? also flip qwindow to 32ms for one pass.
Marco: launching both variants now (64/32ms) — ETA 15m.
Daniel: started trace capture. tagging the run id `run-176534-2` and exporting to dashboard; will post the CSV when done.
Priya: small code-review ping: @Jess when you get to #4217, can you check the KV cache invalidation path I changed? it's subtle when we preempt small-window queues.
Jess: on it. quick note in review: prefer `atomic_replace` vs `delete+create` — risk of transient misses.
Priya: good catch, I'll prep a tiny follow-up.
loadgen-bot: run `run-176534-2` completed. artifacts: /artifacts/loadgen/run-176534-2/summary.json
Daniel: exported metrics CSV: /dash/experiments/cb/176534/metrics.csv — uploaded. initial glance: 64 batch increased tokens/s by ~1.8x but p99 jumped to 120ms for large payloads.
Priya: that's expected tradeoff. can we run one mixing pass: 70% med, 30% large to emulate production mix? want to see whether the heuristic still keeps latency SLO for med.
Marco: yes, will run mix-70-30 next. scheduling after cooldown (10m).
Jess: review complete on #4217, left one comment re: metrics tag names and one nit on a log message. approving pending that.
Priya: summary/action items: 1) Marco run mix-70-30 and upload artifacts (assigned) 2) Daniel export traces + populate dashboard (assigned) 3) Jess merge #4217 after addressing two tiny comments 4) Priya to follow up with a rollback snippet for rollout config.
Marco: running mix now, ETA 20m. will paste quick snapshot when done. :thumbsup:
Priya: thanks everyone. if we see p99 blow up >200ms on med in the mix run, we'll revert the heuristic and open a postmortem. otherwise will promote the change to canary.
Daniel: mix run finished — snapshot: req/s 1,250, tokens/s 72k, p99_med 95ms, p99_large 210ms, queue_time_ms_p95 18ms. uploading traces.
Priya: copying numbers into the CB experiment doc. quick note: Jess — after merge, please include a short rollout plan that ramps traffic 10%->50%->100% with auto-fallback to previous model variant.
Jess: will add rollout steps to the PR description.
Priya: ok closing this thread — will open a follow-up for the canary promotion once rollout config is in. thanks all :)
